name: Ball possession
description: Percentage of time a team controls the ball

name: Expected goals
description: Estimated goals based on shot quality and position

name: Big chances
description: Number of high-quality scoring chances created

name: Goalkeeper saves
description: Saves made by the goalkeeper to prevent goals

name: Corner kicks
description: Number of corners taken

name: Shots on target
description: Shots that would have entered the goal if not saved

name: Hit woodwork
description: Shots that hit the goalpost or crossbar

name: Shots inside box
description: Shots taken from inside the penalty area

name: Shots outside box
description: Shots taken from outside the penalty area

name: Accurate passes
description: Total successful passes to teammates

name: Long balls
description: Accurate long-distance passes

name: Crosses
description: Successful crosses into the opponent's box

name: Duels
description: Percentage of individual duels won

name: Dribbles
description: Success rate of dribble attempts

name: Tackles won
description: Percentage of tackles successfully won

name: Interceptions
description: Number of times a player intercepted a pass

name: Recoveries
description: Times the ball was recovered after a turnover

name: Errors lead to a goal
description: Defensive errors that directly resulted in a goal

name: Goals prevented
description: Goals stopped based on expected goals faced

name: High claims
description: High balls caught or punched by the goalkeeper
